title: Rebel
author: Pr1nted
$comment: Active wartime, but confident rather than desperate: high energy with POSITIVE valence, which is the corner a war you are clearly winning occupies and which nothing else did. The asymmetry signal is what puts the game there -- putting down a rebellion, or fighting someone far smaller, lowers tension and raises valence, and this is what wins that. A war against a peer stays with Parade Uniform and Bombing Voronezh. Editable source: data/audio/midi/Rebel.mid
